gizmo.title: Atisayen lissafi
gizmo.description: Gajeren zagaye na matsalolin lissafi da aka samar tare da ra'ayi nan take. Zaɓi ayyukan lissafi da kewayon lambobi; kowane zagaye sabo ne.

configure.title: Take
configure.description: Sunan wannan atisaye, ana nuna shi a kansa.

configure.title: Ayyukan lissafi
configure.description: Irin matsalolin da ake tambaya. Masu koyo za su iya kashe kowane daga cikinsu kafin su fara.

configure.title: Mafi ƙanƙantar lamba
configure.description: Mafi ƙanƙantar lambar da ake amfani da ita a matsala. Cikakkun lambobi, 0 ko sama.

configure.title: Mafi girman lamba
configure.description: Mafi girman lambar da ake amfani da ita a matsala. Amsoshin rabawa da masu raba suna zama a cikin wannan kewayon ma.

configure.title: Yawan matsaloli
configure.description: Matsaloli nawa ne a zagaye ɗaya (1 zuwa 100).

advanced.title: Iyakar lokaci
advanced.description: Daƙiƙoƙin da aka yarda don gaba ɗaya zagaye. 0 yana nufin babu agogo, wanda shi ne tsoho: atisayen da ke da lokaci suna kayar da masu koyo da ke buƙatar ƙarin lokaci. Idan an saita, masu koyo za su iya kashe agogo don kansu.

advanced.title: Launin ƙawa
advanced.description: Launin guntun kai da maɓallai. Bar shi babu komai don bin jigo.
